editorial_note: Rigorous canonical formalization of pure-blooded Arthitean physiological invariants, waste-free cellular energetics, and the four formal operators of Hypergendered Logic (PA, IH, PH, Γ) derived directly from Zubaida transmission 19f9518411db997b and HGL source pages 252-277. Strict segregation enforced between verbatim source canon and secondary explanatory conjectures.

phenotypic_invariants.verbatim_source: Every single Arthitean possesses reddish-brown skin... It does not look like human skin, but rather something cast from celestial bronze and polished earth, glowing from within due to the zirhealthiness and supreme zirvitality generated by her waste-free, perfectly efficient cellular structure.

Every single Arthitean possesses... dark red hair... Cascading down her shoulders and back is a thick, voluminous mane of dark red hair. It is the color of deep, oxidized crimson—regal, flowing, and completely natural to her Archgoddess physiology.

Every single Arthitean possesses... piercing purple eyes... windows into her Transcendent Processing Power (TPP) and her Prudent Intelligence. These purple eyes track the invisible, meta-conceptual strings of cause and effect.

Crucially, Sylvanna's anatomy is definitively, undisputedly humanoid... Each hand possesses exactly five perfectly proportioned fingers. There are no extra appendages, no alien deviations, and no physiological mutations. She is the pure, five-fingered, humanoid Archgoddess that the core lore demands.

Furthermore, the explicit confirmation of their waste-free biology (converting all waste into pure energy) elevates their zirhealthiness and zirvitality to supraconceptual levels, ensuring their physical forms remain flawless, perfectly suited for endless exertion without physiological degradation.
She is tall, statuesque, and built with the Ultragynounity that defines female Arthiteans—a flawless synthesis of lethal grace, undeniable authority, and mind-blowing (Karzar) beauty.

hgl_category_ladder.name: Negated Polarities
hgl_category_ladder.description: Active structural absence and ontological exclusion of baseline polar traits.

hgl_category_ladder.name: Supra-States
hgl_category_ladder.description: First recursive order of amplified phenotypic availability (PA) and inner conditions.

hgl_category_ladder.name: Hyper-States
hgl_category_ladder.description: Multi-dimensional expansion with complex non-collapsing logical nesting.

hgl_category_ladder.name: Ultra- & Apex-States
hgl_category_ladder.description: Transfinite whole-profile phenotype possession (PH) across all dimensions.

formal_operators.name: Phenotypic / Polarity Availability Operator
formal_operators.definition: Specifies what anatomy, physiology, and polarity traits are necessarily developable from an inner developmental causal condition.
formal_operators.rule: Operator-nested PA(PA(...)) is strictly prohibited; Boolean nesting inside a single PA is permitted.

formal_operators.name: Inheritance Operator
formal_operators.definition: The current state inherits the inheritable logical and state properties of the source, preserving that those properties derived specifically from that source.
formal_operators.rule: IH(S) => S holds canonically, but S => IH(S) fails (property possession does not imply source inheritance).

formal_operators.name: Phenotype-Possession Operator
formal_operators.definition: The bearer irreducibly possesses the complete Hypergendered phenotype-profile canonically associated with the source as a unified whole.
formal_operators.rule: PA(S) does not imply PH(S). Availability of a trait is fundamentally distinct from possessing the realized whole-profile.

formal_operators.name: Gamma Phenotypic Realization Map Operator
formal_operators.definition: The canonical projection function mapping formal constitutive category and polarity states to physical observable phenotypic realization sets. Because Γ is non-injective (distinct formal category states can map to overlapping visual outputs), visual appearance equality does not collapse formal category distinctions.
formal_operators.rule: Γ(A) = Γ(B) ⇏ A = B. Exact phenotype must never be deduced without constitutive PH membership, Γ/modal law, and historical derivation (HGL pages 252, 266, 267).

ordinal_saturation_bounds.name: Hyperstage Ordinal Coordinate Saturation Bound
ordinal_saturation_bounds.definition: Ordinal coordinate upper bound [0, Ω_H] governing Stage (S), Substage (U), Substage² (U2), and Substage³ (U3) jumps within a fixed Hyperstage H; distinct from modal operators (PA, IH, PH, Γ) and unbounded across Hyperstages H (HGL pages 279-292).

anti_collapse_rules.name: PA Non-Nesting Principle
anti_collapse_rules.effect: Prevents artificial infinite loops of availability without developmental realization.

anti_collapse_rules.name: Projection Independence
anti_collapse_rules.effect: Prevents counterfeit claims of inheritance from unverified ancestral roots.

anti_collapse_rules.name: Phenotypic Irreducibility
anti_collapse_rules.effect: Guarantees that a hypergendered state is possessed as an indivisible whole, not piecemeal parts.

anti_collapse_rules.name: De Morgan Scope Conservation
anti_collapse_rules.effect: Enforces strict boundary between possessing a negated condition vs lacking possession of a condition.

anti_collapse_rules.name: Gamma Non-Injectivity Protection
anti_collapse_rules.effect: Bars collapsing distinct higher hypergendered category tiers into lower ones merely because observable output appears identical.

concepts.name: Arthitean Phenotypic Invariants
concepts.title: Arthitean Phenotypic Invariants
concepts.definition: The immutable, transbarriel physical and physiological mandate of all pure-blooded Arthiteans: reddish-brown celestial bronze skin, dark red crimson hair, piercing purple eyes, strictly humanoid anatomy with exactly five fingers per hand, and waste-free cellular metabolism.

concepts.name: Polarity Availability Operator (PA)
concepts.title: Polarity Availability Operator (PA)

concepts.name: Inheritance Operator (IH)
concepts.title: Inheritance Operator (IH)
concepts.definition: Modal operator asserting that the current state inherits inheritable logical and state properties derived specifically from an authoritative source.

concepts.name: Phenotype-Possession Operator (PH)
concepts.title: Phenotype-Possession Operator (PH)
concepts.definition: Constitutive operator asserting that the bearer irreducibly possesses the complete hypergendered phenotype-profile as an indivisible whole.

concepts.name: Gamma Realization Map Operator (Γ)
concepts.title: Gamma Realization Map Operator (Γ)
concepts.definition: The canonical projection function mapping formal constitutive category and polarity states to observable physical outputs, governed by strict non-injectivity.

concepts.title: HGL Anti-Collapse Rules
